races.noteH: Vegetarian by conscience. Carnal Guilt is a mood penalty Elves take when they eat meat, though they ignore the mood penalty of the vegetarian penalty foods (the porridges).
Fast learner but burns out. Growth Fatigue is the debuff a Human gains once they hit maximum experience, a balancing drawback for their faster leveling.

Nocturnal. Lycans run on a night rhythm. Nocturnal - Nighttime applies after dark and moves every one of the 6 major stats by +15%. Nocturnal - Daytime applies during the day and moves the same stats by -10%. Every stat therefore swings from one to the other with the clock, so a Lycan team is built around fighting at night.

gearCt.ddmood: Each point of Mood below 0 adds 8 percent damage dealt; each point above 0 removes 8 percent.
gearCt.cclost: Up to +20 percent crit chance on every hit, in proportion to the HP the wearer has lost: +10 at half HP, +20 at 0 HP, 0 at full HP.
gearCt.healfix: Heals from the fixed part of the hit's damage value only. Ordinary skills and basic attacks build their damage as a share of attack power (SelfCoef) with a fixed part of 0, so they heal nothing.
gearCt.slowcrit: A crit slows the target for 3 seconds. Slow is Movement Speed -30 percent and nothing else, so it changes no damage.

fightCt.hit: Hits can miss (Hit minus Dodge), physical hits can be guarded (guard replaces crit), magic hits are never guarded.
fightCt.energy: A skill waits for Energy. Energy Regeneration (default -0.05) is added once a second; skills spend their Energy Cost, reduced on Easy (-50%) and Normal (-25%).

abyssDayRule: The game stamps the campaign day of your first Abyss entry and every Abyss monster uses that day as its Magic Saturation amount.

consts.summonNote: Summon HP = your MAtk x1 + base HP; summon MAtk = your MAtk x0.5 + base MAtk. Its own abilities read the summon's Magic Attack, not yours.

AFFECTER_DevrickPendant.d: When attacking, absorbs up to 30% of damage dealt as health based on missing health. Heals from the fixed part of the hit's damage value only. Ordinary skills and basic attacks build their damage as a share of attack power (SelfCoef) with a fixed part of 0, so they heal nothing. Heals up to 30% of a hit's flat damage part near 0 HP (15% at half HP, nothing at full HP). Normal skills and basic attacks have no flat part, so they heal nothing.

AFFECTER_BlueBlood.d: Critical Chance increases by up to 20% in proportion to lost health. Up to +20 percent crit chance on every hit, in proportion to the HP the wearer has lost: +10 at half HP, +20 at 0 HP, 0 at full HP.

AFFECTER_ForgottenIdol.d: The damage dealt bonus changes by current Mood × -8%. The lower Mood is, the more damage is dealt. Each point of Mood below 0 adds 8 percent damage dealt; each point above 0 removes 8 percent.

AFFECTER_StickyBedstraw.d: Dealing critical damage applies Slow to the target for 3 seconds. A crit slows the target for 3 seconds. Slow is Movement Speed -30 percent and nothing else, so it changes no damage.

magicSatInfo.tip:
As days pass, monsters in the Abyssal Dungeon grow stronger.
The strengthening effects are cumulative.

Day 0–20 : Magic Saturation Level 1
Day 20–40 : Magic Saturation Level 2
Day 40–60 : Magic Saturation Level 3
Day 60–100 : Magic Saturation Level 4 The bonus is capped at 100. Day bands add health, then attacks, then resists, then damage dealt and damage taken.

For each day that has passed in this stage, all monsters' Max Health Total increases by 1%.

For each day that has passed in this stage, all monsters' Physical Attack Power and Magic Attack Power increase by 1%.

For each day that has passed in this stage, all monsters' Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance increase by 1.

For each day that has passed in the current stage, all monsters' Damage Dealt and Damage Taken increase by 0.5%.
